assets.name: emblem-client-net.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original pixel-art game-management UI emblem representing client network transport. TWO CHUNKY TEAL DATA CONNECTOR PLUGS with brass contact tips meet diagonally at the center, with a thick coiled cable looping above and below them. Build a COMPACT NEARLY SQUARE silhouette: opaque subject bounding box aspect ratio 0.9 to 1.1, filling most of the square in BOTH height and width. This replaces an unreadably thin horizontal connector icon; avoid a horizontal strip, thin wire, wing or moustache silhouette. The two blocky plug bodies should each be large enough to remain recognizable when the full image is shown at 32px. Design like a 32x32 logical grid icon destined for exact 64x64 and 32x32 UI use. Bold crisp one-logical-pixel dark outline #1a120b, upper-left lighting, flat two-step shading, at most 12 colors: dark brown #1a120b, brown #3b2a1e, teal #3fa7a7 and its dark/light variants, brass #e3b24a, cream #fdf6e6. Modest transparent padding, centered, genuinely transparent alpha background. No badge, background plate, ground shadow, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logos, people, animals or copied game art. No smooth gradient or antialiasing. The cable coil contributes substantial vertical volume; overall shape should have similar height and visual weight to a small server rack or monitor icon.
assets.revisionReason: Independent design critique D-03: square composition for 64px and 32px legibility
